question: What rises when, in clefts and nights and midday?
premises: in cleft, beyond lunar-solar, in vasu-cleft the moon-bull-limb-serpent pair holds
first-night, midnight, midday-night mark the hours
inference: Clefts and night-watches order the day-rise at midday.
uncertainties: randhra (cleft) stations kept technical; pair referents open
plain_english: In cleft, beyond lunar-solar, in vasu-cleft the moon-bull-limb-serpent pair — first-night, midnight, midday-night; day-rise is midday.
